## Procedure

## Tips & gotchas

- Compare your potential replacement knob against the inner rod before committing. [t1662]
- Note that horizontal buttons convert to vertical pressure via an angled block mechanism. [t1662]

## Common mistakes

- Ripping off wires connected to Overdrive (OD) buttons during removal. [t1662]
- Breaking the base of a shifter knob without realizing it was held by screws only. [t1662]
- Damaging wiring that runs through the body of the shifter instead of using connectors. [t1662]
